people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Because of this I have sent Timothy to you, who is my beloved and faithful child in the Lord, who will remind you of my ways which are in Christ, even as I teach everywhere in every assembly.
translations.bsb: That is why I have sent you Timothy, my beloved and faithful child in the Lord. He will remind you of my way of life in Christ Jesus, which is exactly what I teach everywhere in every church.
translations.kjv: For ➔ this cause have I sent unto you Timotheus, who is my beloved son, and faithful in the Lord, who shall bring ➔ you into remembrance of my ways which be in Christ, as I teach every where in every church.
translations.asv: For this cause have I sent unto you Timothy, who is my beloved and faithful child in the Lord, who shall put you in remembrance of my ways which are in Christ, even as I teach everywhere in every church.
